test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PLASTIC’ is written as ‘TSPLICA’, and ‘DARWIN’ is written as ‘WRNIDA’. How will ‘MANICURE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letter according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The pattern followed here is:**

Logic: The alphabet is arranged in decreasing order.

'PLASTIC' is written as 'TSPLICA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99fc26881ca2406e85ad2d4c446c22e4c920ad263c091b2ce8743a09aec5ce29.png] 

And,

'DARWIN' is written as 'WRNIDA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44e18b42e9daeb468dd305613c22964a6f9b0adcf486ed56808b4bb200a285c0.png] 

Similarly,

'MANICURE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/814be5448c8db0c3beb2f07bb5d0a4594832e7aba694490cba2e0cd26b303859.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "URNMIECA"
